lines.say: Mahgoo Mahgoo no Mee. The Magma-Magma Fruit. A power so hot, it can burn fire itself.
lines.show: Magu Magu no Mi. The Magma-Magma Fruit. A power so hot, it can burn fire itself.

lines.say: It's a Lohjeeah fruit. Its user can create magma, control magma, and turn into magma.
lines.show: It's a Logia fruit. Its user can create magma, control magma, and turn into magma.

lines.say: It belongs to Sah-kah-zoo-kee, the Marine known as Ahkahyeenoo. The name means Red Dog.
lines.show: It belongs to Sakazuki, the Marine known as Akainu. The name means Red Dog.

lines.say: The three admirals had colour-and-animal names. A red dog, a blue pheasant, and a yellow monkey.
lines.show: The three admirals had colour-and-animal names. A red dog, a blue pheasant, and a yellow monkey.

lines.say: His creed? Absolute Justice. No mercy for pirates. Ever.
lines.show: His creed? Absolute Justice. No mercy for pirates. Ever.

lines.say: Years before, during the Buster Call on Oh-hah-rah, he even sank a ship full of fleeing people.
lines.show: Years before, during the Buster Call on Ohara, he even sank a ship full of fleeing people.

lines.say: At Marineford, he rained giant fists of magma down on the pirate ships. Meteor Volcano.
lines.show: At Marineford, he rained giant fists of magma down on the pirate ships. Meteor Volcano.

lines.say: And that war proved it. Magma burns hotter than fire. Even a fire Lohjeeah couldn't stand against it.
lines.show: And that war proved it. Magma burns hotter than fire. Even a fire Logia couldn't stand against it.

lines.say: After the war, he fought Ah-oh-kee-jee on Punk Hazard for the top seat. Magma against ice, for ten days.
lines.show: After the war, he fought Aokiji on Punk Hazard for the top seat. Magma against ice, for ten days.

lines.say: Magma won. Half of that island still burns today.
lines.show: Magma won. Half of that island still burns today.

lines.say: And the Red Dog became Fleet Admiral, the head of the entire Marines.
lines.show: And the Red Dog became Fleet Admiral, the head of the entire Marines.

lines.say: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
lines.show: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
